This man is hated by every crow in Seattle.
In 2006, a scientist put on a creepy caveman mask, and caught seven crows on his campus.
He tagged them, measured them, and let them all go. No harm done.
The next time he walked across campus in that mask, the crows lost their minds.
Screaming. Diving. Following him from tree to tree.
Okay, fair. Those seven remembered his face.
Year two, more crows joined in. Crows he had never even touched.
Year five, baby crows that weren't even born yet were screaming at the mask too.
Their parents taught them. Crows point out dangerous faces to their kids, and the grudge spreads.
Then the scientists tried one more test.
They put the same mask on a totally innocent person.
The crows screamed at them anyway.
They don't hate the man. They hate the face.
And without the mask? He walks right past them. Nothing.
